company.name: Tarjama
company.shortDescription: Tarjama& provides language and translation services for businesses in different markets.
company.description: Tarjama, a certified translation agency in Dubai and across the region, understands that in order to compete in today’s global market, businesses must be able to connect with their customers and stakeholders and communicate about their products and services in a way that fits into the regional and cultural context. What works in Europe or the US may simply not work in the Middle East. As cultural and linguistic experts, we help you transcend geographic borders and communicate globally!
